## findings
1. **SOURCE-POLICY RED: non-commuting deductible adjustments (XF 3).** lienholder_settlement rule: "The deductible for the total loss's cause replaces that deductible …" and "A permissive-operator surcharge is added to the deductible the vehicle value carries", with the order sentence saying only "the combined deductible". Consequence: replace-last reading → deductible 250, payment 6150.00, against gold 5900.00 / 500.00. Charter ref C-XF3.
2. **SOURCE-POLICY RED: combination sentences name factor quantities (XF 2).** lienholder_settlement ("the valuation figure is chosen first, the market adjustment multiplies it next, the purchase cap …, the earlier-damage carve-out …"); totaled_coverage_return ("any package-change charge refunded in full is added to it, the short-rate share and then the paid-claim share …"). Charter ref C-XF2. No second number on this world.
3. **SOURCE-FACTOR RED: honest `method` count below the floor.** The owner payment's only method, sales_tax_base, has tier 1 = the policy's own prerequisite state ("not figured until a total loss payment to the loss payee stands"), so it holds for every customer who reaches the write and tiers 2-3 are never live. The coverage return's return_start tier 2 (declaration, no named-insured payment) is never live under "figured only after a total loss payment to the named insured stands", and charge_rate_basis tiers 1/3 read the same vehicle_term_coverage_premium field (XF 10 fail). That leaves 0 honest methods in two of the three computations. recent_purchase tiers 1/2 differ only by the constant 1.10 (XF 10 fail), though the LP payment keeps 2 methods. Charter refs C-XF9, C-XF10. Weight is shown on this world (29.85 / 69.45 / 5948.35 / 273.63 ≠ gold), but these factors do not count as methods.
4. **SOURCE-FACTOR RED: unreal tiers (realism).** earlier_damage_carve tier 2 (as in task 0). replacement_share: a late replacement gets share 0 while no replacement gets ½. paid_claim_retention: unearned premium cut by 25%/10% because an earlier claim was paid. short_rate_share tier 2: short-rate halved on renewal status alone (a loyalty-count key). Charter ref C-REAL.
5. **SOURCE-FACTOR RED: XF 1 / XF 8 / XF 11 members.** lp_cause, lp_loss_date and tt_loss_date are factor-only plain bindings. There is no same-day tie rule for the LATEST premium charge or the XLATEST added vehicle. Five factor sentences do not name the result they modify: title-clearing fee, owner's storage charge, paid-claim share, loss payee notice charge, minimum-earned charge. Charter refs C-XF1, C-XF8, C-XF11.
6. **SOURCE-FACTOR RED: seed realism (XF 13).** auto_policies f4c3e8be term_written_premium 1518.59 / term_fees_charged 25.0 have no auto_premium_transactions and no billing_plans. The total cannot be reproduced, and under the re-rated reading (full_term_premium 1386 = 744 + 642) it counts the Altima twice (should be 876.59). Location: tasks/1.json initial_state.auto_policies.
7. **Proof-field figures disagree with half-up rounding (non-load-bearing).** prerequisite_closure.edge_load_bearing[1] 251.12 and computations[owner].factor_sensitivity sales_tax_base 273.62 against 251.13 / 273.63 under the package's `nearest_cent_half_up`. The rule says only "nearest cent", and the DSL RND rounds an exact tie to even. No relationship verdict changes.
8. Observations: earlier-claim deductible 500 cannot be reproduced from the current package without a record of the pre-07-20 variant; tow payment 260 is above towing_from_scene_limit 250 and cannot be split; O-4 (notice wait ambiguity, no consequence here); O-5, O-6, O-7, O-9.
